sources.title: SmallAICreator/GRAFT-1B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GRAFT-1B is a ~1B-parameter chat model from UltraLabs. It was made by shrinking Qwen3-1.7B with GRAFT, our own gradient-free, closed-form model-shrinking method, and then healing, distilling and chat-tuning the result.
